lockedApplication.title: Your application opens after your consultation
lockedApplication.body: Your consultant will set up your plan and document checklist first. We’ll notify you as soon as it’s ready to use.

draft_intake.title: Finish your intake
draft_intake.body: Answer the intake questions and submit them for your consultant to review. Your progress is saved.

intake_submitted.title: Intake received
intake_submitted.body: Your consultant is reviewing your intake and will contact you to arrange a consultation. Nothing is needed from you.

consultation_requested.title: Consultation requested
consultation_requested.body: Your consultant will contact you to agree a time. Nothing is needed from you.

consultation_booked.title: Consultation booked
consultation_booked.body: Your consultation is arranged. Bring any questions you have about your case.

consultation_completed.title: Consultation completed
consultation_completed.body: Your consultant is preparing your plan. We’ll update you here.

plan_created.title: Your plan is being finalised
plan_created.body: Next, your consultant will list the documents you need. Your application opens after that.

requirements_added.title: Almost ready
requirements_added.body: Your document checklist has been set. Your consultant will activate your application shortly.

closed.title: Case closed
closed.body: After your consultation, your consultant did not proceed with an application. Contact them if you have questions.

not_started.title: Application not open yet
not_started.body: Your application opens after your consultation and plan.

application_activated.title: Your application is open
application_activated.body: Your document checklist is ready. Upload the requested documents to continue.

waiting_documents.title: Upload your documents
waiting_documents.body: Upload every document on your checklist. Your consultant reviews them once they’re in.

documents_under_review.title: Documents under review
documents_under_review.body: Your consultant is checking your files. We’ll notify you of the result.

documents_not_approved.title: Some documents need fixing
documents_not_approved.body: Open your application to read your consultant’s notes and upload replacements.

documents_approved.title: Documents approved
documents_approved.body: Your consultant is preparing to submit your application.

visa_journey_started.title: Application submitted
visa_journey_started.body: Your consultant has submitted your application to Home Affairs. Processing takes time. We’ll update you here.

visa_issue_action_needed.title: Home Affairs needs more information
visa_issue_action_needed.body: Your consultant will contact you about what is required.

finished.title: Your visa application was successful
finished.body: Congratulations. Your consultant will share any final steps.

cancelled.title: Application ended
cancelled.body: Your visa application was unsuccessful. Your consultant will talk through your options.

profile_incomplete.title: Complete your profile
profile_incomplete.body: Add your contact details and background so your consultant can help you. Your progress is saved.

no_case.title: Create your case
no_case.body: Your profile is complete. Create your case so a consultant can review it and arrange your consultation.

draft_intake.title: Waiting for the client
draft_intake.body: The client is still completing their profile. Nothing to do yet.

intake_submitted.title: Review the intake
intake_submitted.body: Read the client’s answers, then contact them to arrange a consultation.

consultation_requested.title: Arrange the consultation
consultation_requested.body: Agree a time with the client, then mark the consultation as booked.

consultation_booked.title: Hold the consultation
consultation_booked.body: After the meeting, mark the consultation as completed.

consultation_completed.title: Decide: create a plan or close
consultation_completed.body: Create a plan to proceed, or close the case if it can’t go ahead.

plan_created.title: Add the document checklist
plan_created.body: Select the documents this client must provide.

requirements_added.title: Activate the application
requirements_added.body: Activating creates the Drive folder and notifies the client.

closed.title: Case closed
closed.body: This case was not taken forward after the consultation.

not_started.title: Application not activated
not_started.body: The application stays in this placeholder state until the case is activated.

application_activated.title: Application activated
application_activated.body: The client can now upload documents.

waiting_documents.title: Waiting for documents
waiting_documents.body: The client is uploading the requested files.

documents_under_review.title: Review the documents
documents_under_review.body: Approve the documents, or reject them with a note for the client.

documents_not_approved.title: Waiting for corrected files
documents_not_approved.body: The client has been notified. Review again once they re-upload.

documents_approved.title: Start the visa journey
documents_approved.body: All documents are approved. Submit to Home Affairs, then mark the journey as started.

visa_journey_started.title: Track the application
visa_journey_started.body: Flag an issue if Home Affairs needs more, or record the outcome.

visa_issue_action_needed.title: Resolve the Home Affairs request
visa_issue_action_needed.body: Collect what is missing, then resume the journey or record the outcome.

confirm.closed: Close this case? The client will see that no application will proceed.
confirm.application_activated: This will create (or reuse) the client’s Drive profile folder, open a new application folder, and notify the client. Continue?
confirm.cancelled: Mark this application as unsuccessful? The client will be notified.
